title: Bills star accuses JetBlue of stealing fiancee’s jewelry, Rolex watches

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bills star accuses JetBlue of stealing fiancee’s jewelry, Rolex watches
sources.description: Bills left tackle Dion Dawkins claimed that JetBlue employees allegedly stole jewelry, including Rolex watches, from his fiancée, Daiyaana Muhammad's bag while the pair flew first class from Los Angeles to Fort Lauderdale recently.
